keywords.term: human in the loop AI agents
keywords.note: Used 2026-08-13 → content/news/2026-08-13-human-in-the-loop-ai-agents-{en,zh}.mdx (title 'Human in the Loop for AI Agents: When to Add a Gate'). The concept hub the whole site implicitly points to (automate the work, keep a hand on the writes).
